title: Catalogue entry before offering

statement.en: A data provider shall publish a catalogue entry for each data product before offering it, conforming to the metadata profile set at Level 1, and the entry shall include at least the usage conditions, a personal-data flag and an AI-use flag. The catalogue service shall validate the entry against the profile before it becomes visible.

control: Automatic validation against the profile at publication; periodic check that every offered product has a valid entry
trustFramework: none; the provider's identity is validated under dssc:M1.participation.01

expressions.note: SHACL shape on the DCAT-AP view of the offer, extended by the Level 1 metadata profile.

source: DS4Skills rulebook v0.4 CAT-01, CAT-02, CAT-11
